summary: Initializes the msvcrt CRT heap sub-allocator: allocates a 0x140-byte block from the private heap hHeap, records the returned base pointer, resets the free-list and block counters to 0, stores the caller-supplied maximum allocation size, and sets the initial realloc capacity to 16. Returns 1 on success, or the NULL HeapAlloc result when the allocation fails.

operations.description: Call HeapAlloc(hHeap, 0, 0x140) to allocate a 320-byte block from the private heap.
Store the returned allocation pointer into lpMem (0x008D48FC).
Guard: proceed only when the allocation result is non-NULL; otherwise fall through and return the NULL result.
Set dword_8D48F0 (cursor/base of the allocated region) to the allocation result.
Set dword_8D4900 to the caller's parameter a1 (maximum allocation size).
Return 1 on successful initialization, or the NULL HeapAlloc result when the allocation failed.
Called by sub_59325D (0x0059325D) during msvcrt heap sub-allocator setup.
